description: This file contains utility code for testing HostResolverInternalResult objects in the net::dns namespace, including custom Google Test matchers for different result types and an operator to output results as JSON.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResultBaseMatcher
classes.description: Abstract base class for Google Test matchers that verify properties of HostResolverInternalResult objects, including domain name, query type, source, expiration, and subtype-specific properties.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResultMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of subtype 'kData', verifying endpoints, strings, and hosts.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResultMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of subtype 'kMetadata', verifying metadatas.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResultMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of subtype 'kError', verifying error code.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResultMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for HostResolverInternalResult objects of subtype 'kAlias', verifying alias target.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalDataResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for 'kData' results with specified properties.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalMetadataResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for 'kMetadata' results with specified properties.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalErrorResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for 'kError' results with specified properties.

methods.name: ExpectHostResolverInternalAliasResult
methods.description: Factory function returning a matcher for 'kAlias' results with specified properties.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const HostResolverInternalResult&)
methods.description: Outputs the HostResolverInternalResult as a JSON string to the stream.
